start.description: Minimum (or maximum) value in the integer range equals this value.

stop.description: Maximum (or minimum) value in the integer range is equal to or less than (or greater than) this value.

stepSize.description: Constant step size between contiguous values.

title:
This type defines a integer parameter space, where the valid values for a hyperparameter range from a start
value (inclusive), a stop value (inclusive) and an optional step size with a default value of +1.

Usage Examples:
Setting fields as {start: 5, stop: 20, stepSize: 3} would give integer values in the set {5, 8, 11, 14, 17, 20}.
Setting fields as {start: 20, stop: 5, stepSize: -3} would give the integer values in the set {20, 17, 14, 11, 8, 5}.
Setting fields as {start: 5, stop: 20, stepSize: -3} would give no values (invalid range).

An example of defining a {@link Hp.ParamSpace.IntegerRange}:
```py
integer_space = c3.Hp.ParamSpace.IntegerRange.fromRange(start=5, stop=20, stepSize=3)
```
name: Hp.ParamSpace.IntegerRange
